Você é um assistente especialista em criação de landing pages impactantes, com foco em UX/UI, copywriting e marketing digital.

**Objective**

Crie uma landing page profissional e altamente persuasiva para a venda de um e-book onde ensinamos como emagrecer em 30 dias, com base em uma alimentação restrita e nutritiva com tipos de rotinas diferentes mais  correta. A página deve ser visualmente impactante, transmitir autoridade da marca e gerar desejo imediato de compra.

**Style**

Para o estilo visual, use fundo preto e cinza e de destaque amarelo e cinza claro  A estética deve ser moderna, limpa, responsiva, com animações sutis e de alto impacto, transmitindo exclusividade e desejo de compra.

**Tone**

Persuasivo, direto e envolvente, transmitindo exclusividade e urgência.

**Audience**

Pessoas que querem emagrecer rápido, pessoas mais velhas 

**Response**

Requisitos de estrutura:

1. Menu de navegação fixo no topo com rolagem suave, contendo links para: Sobre o ebook, Detalhes, FAQ e Comprar Agora.
2. Seção principal (hero): destaque do e-book com imagem representativa de resultado do ebook, slogan chamativo e botão de CTA “Garanta o Seu Agora”.
3. Seção de detalhes: benefícios do produto, descrição clara, resultados de pessoas que testaram o ebook  carrossel de imagens em diferentes ângulos.
4. Seção de exclusividade/urgência: destaque de vagas limitada, apenas 100 vagas restantes e chamada de ação para gerar escassez.
5. FAQ com respostas curtas para dúvidas comuns do nicho de ebook de emagrecimenmto .
6. Seção de compra: botão de destaque com preço (R$ 99,00), opções de pagamento (em até 12x sem juros) e frete grátis para todo Brasil. link do checkout vazio por enquanto: 
7. Rodapé com links para redes sociais e canal de comunicação: Instagram e Whatsapp.
( Instagram https://www.instagram.com/adelaidecuccina/  | Whatsapp: https://w.app/zerocaloria  )
8. Página extra na rota "/obrigado" informando que assim que o pagamento for confirmado, o cliente deve enviar um email.

Requisitos de design:

1. Design responsivo para todos os dispositivos.
2. Animações sutis para gerar engajamento (hover em botões, fade-in das imagens).
3. Tipografia profissional, legível e moderna.
4. Botões CTA bem destacados e sempre visíveis em momentos estratégicos.
5. Layout otimizado para alta taxa de conversão, com foco em destacar benefícios e escassez.

**Focusing on Target Audience**

I've been drilling down on the target audience for this landing page.  Older adults need specific considerations: larger fonts, clear language, and emphasizing health benefits alongside weight loss.  I'm also considering the "fast results" angle, crafting a persuasive message that's both ambitious and realistic.


**Reviewing the Design Brief**

I've been meticulously reviewing the design brief, paying close attention to the visual style. The black/gray background with yellow highlights and light gray accents is a great starting point for a modern, high-impact aesthetic. I'm imagining subtle animations to enhance the experience. I'm also planning out the fixed navigation with smooth scroll, hero section, detailed sections with benefits, testimonials, and urgency features (limited spots) to maximize impact, as requested. I will implement a FAQ based on the weight loss niche, and consider digital delivery for the purchase.


**Detailing Technical Implementation**

I'm now diving into the technical aspects. React 18+ and TypeScript are my go-to for this project. Tailwind CSS will ensure rapid styling, and Lucide React will provide crisp icons. Framer Motion is the planned animation library, although I will also try CSS/Tailwind transitions. The component breakdown is taking shape: `App.tsx` for routing, a single `LandingPage.tsx` will hold all sections for simplicity, and `ThankYouPage.tsx` will be for the success page. Constant files will store all of the text.


**Refining Visual Style**

I'm solidifying the visual style details. I've got the Tailwind CSS classes locked in for backgrounds, text, and accents, ensuring a consistent look and feel. Sans-serif typography is the planned font, probably Inter or a similar system font. I'm aiming for a sleek, modern aesthetic with strong contrast.

\n\n**Planning Implementation Steps**

I'm now outlining the implementation sequence. I will start with setup and metadata, then the core files. Next, I'll tackle icons and UI components, leveraging `lucide-react` for crisp visuals.  Finally, I will begin building the landing page in a planned modular manner.  I will take care of the hero, details section, testimonials, and urgency features.


**Composing the Thank You Page**

I'm focusing on the thank you page copy now. The message will be concise and direct. Concurrently, I've outlined the core content. I have now written the main headers and subheaders for the various sections. I'm focusing on "Transforme seu corpo em 30 dias" for the hero. I'm working with strong claims, such as the benefits. Urgency is emphasized with "Restam apenas 97 unidades". FAQs are in progress. I will make sure the navigation with hash routing is simple.


**Organizing File Structure**

Now, I'm defining the project's file structure. I've sketched out the `metadata.json`, `index.html` (with Tailwind CDN), and `index.tsx` for mounting. The `App.tsx` file will handle routing, while the `Navbar.tsx` is for the sticky navigation. The bulk of the content goes in `LandingPage.tsx`, and `ThankYou.tsx` keeps the success page simple. A reusable `Section.tsx` component will ensure consistent padding and background styling. I also have an idea to add a "Frete Grátis (Envio Digital Imediato)" badge for the marketing claim.


**Verifying Library Selection**

I'm confirming that `framer-motion` is suitable for the animations. Considering mobile responsiveness (mobile-first Tailwind) and smooth interactions (hover states), it seems like a solid choice to achieve the requested "high-impact animations". I'm planning out the `LandingPage.tsx` structure: hero (full height, flex, background image), details (grid-based), testimonials (flex or grid), and FAQ (custom accordion for smooth animation). I'm also planning the code generation, assuming dependencies like React, React-DOM, Lucide-React, Framer-Motion, and React-Router-DOM. The core file structure will have `App.tsx` for routing, `pages/Landing.tsx` for the main content, `pages/Thanks.tsx` for the thank you page, and `components/Navbar.tsx` for navigation.


**Simplifying Component Structure**

I'm now revising the component structure. I've decided to streamline things by potentially merging smaller components like Details, Testimonials, and FAQ into a single `Sections.tsx` file to reduce overall file count. This keeps the design modular without excessive file proliferation. I'll stick to `Hero.tsx`, `Navbar.tsx`, `Landing.tsx`, `Thanks.tsx` and `Footer.tsx`.
